details:
The search feature is quite basic atm, also some authors just never fill all the information to the description. But with the new things like Native Face Tracking/imposter(NOT every market avatars have imposter), and possible to have things like built-in Fly, material shift, cloth(mesh) change(that's affect performance) or something like that. This will encourage authors to bring face tracking to the avatar market, I think the only one using the native FT so far is the one in the picture 1, but the author forgot to tag it's supporting FT so you can never search if you type face tracking in the search section lol

Also, btw, the tags in the search seems fit and never changed, Japanese community do use different tags include things in Japanese or something like kemomimi, btw. Some do use avatar tags, which don't seems useful in the first glare, but allowing the tag to go into the search section means authors can be encourage to add avatar with market cloth that's not default cloth, I have no idea why all the market avatars are default, many VRChatter don't use default avatars
title: [1949] Add Avatar Marketplace search filter for 'Features' like native face tracking
